records.title: Non-FDA Module 1 backbones are still invented; they are now honestly labelled and partly fenced, but still selectable and buildable in Submission Center

GET /api/submissions/market-support is at server/routes/submissions.ts:330-358. client/src/concept2cure/v2/surfaces/NewSubmissionForm.tsx:137-140 labels each region option with the server's summary. server/routes/c2c/projects.ts:761 refuses a not_offered filing at project creation. dispatch-readiness.ts JP_ECTD_V4_REQUIRED blocks a new PMDA original. Still open: client/src/concept2cure/v2/fixtures/submission.ts:26-39 SC_REGIONS still offers all 12 regions. server/routes/submissions.ts:181 accepts all 14 region codes. submission-service.ts:567-578 createSequence checks only sequenceTypeRefusal (FDA 'variation'), not the offer tier, so an EU/JP/CA/UK… sequence can be created and assembled. regional-backbone-readiness.ts:138-140 regionalBackboneRequiredFromEnv is still opt-in, and no deploy/Docker/helm file sets ECTD_REQUIRE_REGIONAL_BACKBONE (grep over the repo outside docs). records.fixedBy: a3dd2889b (server/services/regulatory/market-support.ts; regional-backbone-readiness.ts module1ShapeOf), 2ca6f29d4 (server/routes/c2c/projects.ts:761 refuses not_offered; Health Canada adapter stops posting), cbe8cd038 (JP_ECTD_V4_REQUIRED in server/services/ectd/dispatch-readiness.ts), 8f1c2ba5f (FDA conformance earned per build)
records.remaining: (1) The EU, PMDA, HC and eight placeholder backbones are unchanged and still not agency-conformant. (2) Submission Center still offers all 12 regions (labelled, not hidden). The server accepts a submission and sequence 0000 for any of them and packages a flat or placeholder Module 1 with only a warning. The market verdict's 'author_only' tier is enforced nowhere in createSequence or assemble. (3) The production regional-backbone gate is still opt-in and unset everywhere. (4) The generic adapters (CESP for national/MRP/DCP, MHRA, NMPA, TGA, Swissmedic, ANVISA, CDSCO, MFDS, HSA) would still POST to unsourced endpoints if credentials were configured. That contradicts ADAPTER_UNSOURCED's 'nothing is sent through it' (transport-refusals.ts).
records.severityRationale: The pilot is FDA-only, and the FDA backbone is the one region whose conformance is earned per build. Every non-FDA market is now labelled as Flat/Placeholder Module 1 or not offered at the moment a region is chosen. New PMDA applications are blocked at dispatch. No non-FDA transmit can complete without per-agency credentials, which the pilot will not have. What remains is a misleading but labelled build path for out-of-scope regions, which belongs before enterprise GA.
records.humanTestingNote: In Submission Center > New submission, a tester can pick EU (EMA), PMDA, Health Canada, MHRA or any of the other 8 regions. The option text now reads e.g. 'EU (EMA) · Flat Module 1, no channel'. The tester can then create sequence 0000 and assemble a package whose <cc>-regional.xml is a flat or placeholder Module 1, flagged only as a warning ('NOT an EU-conformant Module 1 backbone'). Workaround: test with FDA (US) only and treat any non-FDA package as non-conformant by design.
records.instructions:
1. Founder: confirm in writing that the pilot is FDA-only and that non-FDA markets are author-only (documents authored in Projects, no sequence built). Record the decision in docs/LAUNCH_DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md under D2.
2. Server, sequence creation: in server/services/submission-service/submission-service.ts createSequence (:567), after the sequenceTypeRefusal check at :578, read the submission's market verdict with readMarketSupport (server/services/regulatory/market-support.ts) for { applicationType: parent.applicationType, market: input.region } and again for parent.primaryRegion. Call it with the request-scoped client, as server/routes/submissions.ts:351 does: thread a queryable through createSequence's ctx, or add a pure marketOfferGivenOutline call as projects.ts:760 does. Throw SubmissionError('VALIDATION', offer.reason) unless offer.tier === 'build_and_sequence'. This also covers AnA and MCP callers, because they reach createSequence.
3. Server, submission creation: in the POST / handler at server/routes/submissions.ts:244, compute the same offer for (applicationType, primaryRegion). Answer 422 FILING_NOT_OFFERED with offer.reason when the tier is not_offered. Allow author_only, but return the offer on the created row so the UI can say no sequence will be built.
4. Client: in client/src/concept2cure/v2/surfaces/NewSubmissionForm.tsx submissionFields (:137-140), mark the region options whose server statement for the chosen application type is not 'build_and_sequence' as disabled, keeping the server's reason as the option text. Extend MarketSupportView in client/src/concept2cure/v2/MarketSupportLine.tsx:20 with `offer`. Do not delete SC_REGIONS (client/src/concept2cure/v2/fixtures/submission.ts:26). Authoring for those markets stays reachable through New project (server/routes/c2c/projects.ts:761, client/src/concept2cure/v2/surfaces/Projects.tsx and ProjectMarkets.tsx), which is the replacement path that CLAUDE.md requires to be named.
5. Adapters: make each generic adapter that ADAPTER_UNSOURCED describes (ema-cesp.ts transmit, mhra-gateway.ts:67, nmpa-gateway.ts, tga-ebs-gateway.ts, swissmedic, anvisa, cdsco, mfds, hsa) throw UnverifiedTransportError before any network call, the way health-canada-gateway.ts does (HC_REFUSAL, :57-61). Keep EUDAMED out of scope for the FDA pilot.
6. Leave the ECTD_REQUIRE_REGIONAL_BACKBONE default to CAT2-08, so that the posture record in server/services/ectd/__tests__/submission-gate-posture.test.ts is changed once, deliberately.
7. Work on concept2cure-v2 only, and merge, never rebase. No schema change is needed.
records.acceptance: (a) Failing first: a pglite test calls createSequence for a submission with primaryRegion 'eu' and applicationType 'maa'. It expects SubmissionError VALIDATION carrying the market's offer.reason, and it is red at HEAD 94b4f9238, which inserts the row. It goes green after step 2. (b) The same test for fda/ind still creates 0000. (c) A client test renders NewSubmissionForm with a stubbed market-support response and asserts that 'EU (EMA)' is disabled for MAA and 'FDA (US)' is enabled for IND. It is red at HEAD. (d) A unit test asserts that MhraGateway.transmit throws UnverifiedTransportError with credentials set and never calls httpsRequest. It is red at HEAD. (e) Existing pre-transmit and regional-backbone-readiness tests stay green.
records.dependencies: Founder decision on launch regions (catalog2 open question). Building real EU, JP or CA Module 1 backbones depends on CAT2-01 (agency DTDs) and is XL. The production gate default belongs to CAT2-08. Adapter refusal overlaps CAT2-05.

records.title: New shadow-review runs record only the deterministic severity aggregate; legacy v1.0 model-influenced scores are still shown unlabelled in Submission Center
records.evidenceAtHead: At 92ccdba1, shadow-review-service.ts:224-226 had rtfRiskScore = Math.max(clamp01(output.rtfRiskScore, agg.rtf), agg.rtf). At HEAD, server/services/shadow-review/shadow-review-service.ts:248-250 computes `const { rtf: rtfRiskScore, crl: crlRiskScore } = aggregateRisk(findings)` and nothing else. ShadowReviewOutput (:42-45) has no score field. SHADOW_REVIEW_PROMPT_VERSION='shadow-review@v1.1' (:50), and prompts/shadow-review/v1.1.md:45-46 says 'Do not estimate a probability or a score of any kind'. An empty sequence gets a server-side critical finding (:248). The AnA tool path (AnaToolExecutor.ts:9820) and the REST path (submissions.ts:1252) both call the same runShadowReview. The dispatch gate reads only critical-finding counts and run presence (assess-dispatch-readiness.ts:740-758), never the score. Residual: listShadowReviewRuns (:294-306) returns stored rtf_risk_score as-is. client/src/concept2cure/v2/surfaces/SubmissionSeqWorkspaces.tsx:1168-1178 ShadowRunRow has no basis field, and :1380-1381 renders r.rtfRiskScore.toFixed(2) for every run, including v1.0 rows whose stored figure was max(model, aggregate). ShadowReview.tsx:137,200-203 labels v1.0 rows, but SubmissionSeqWorkspaces does not. scripts/seed/ga-demo.d/107-shadow-review.mjs:206 writes prompt_version 'shadow-review@v1.0' for deterministic seed scores (scoreDims :135-141), so seeded runs are mislabelled as 'model_reported'.
records.fixedBy: 5cce2ae46 (server/services/shadow-review/shadow-review-service.ts:248-250 aggregate only; prompt v1.1; ShadowReview.tsx scoreBasis), 72264e368
records.remaining: (1) Shadow-review runs recorded before 2026-10-05 under prompt v1.0 still carry a model-influenced score, and the Submission Center Shadow Review runs table (SubmissionSeqWorkspaces.tsx:1380-1381) shows it with no basis label. (2) The GA demo seed tags its deterministic runs as v1.0, so the Shadow Review surface tells testers (and AnA) the score was the model's own estimate when it was not.
records.severityRationale: The Rule 2 defect (the model setting the RTF/CRL number) is closed for every run created since 2026-10-05, and the dispatch gate never read the score. A fresh pilot production database has no v1.0 rows. The remainder is display and labelling of legacy or seeded rows.
records.humanTestingNote: Only visible on a database holding shadow-review runs from before 2026-10-05, or seeded by the GA demo pack. In those cases, Submission Center > sequence > Shadow Review shows an older RTF/CRL number with no note that it may be the model's estimate. The Shadow Review surface says seeded runs kept 'the reviewer model's own estimate', which is untrue for seed rows. Workaround: re-run the lens; new runs are aggregate-only and are labelled correctly.
records.instructions:
1. In server/services/shadow-review/shadow-review-service.ts listShadowReviewRuns (:294), map each row to add `scoreBasis: scoreBasisOf(row.promptVersion)`. For rows whose basis is 'model_reported', replace rtfRiskScore and crlRiskScore with aggregateRisk() over that run's persisted findings. Use one extra org-scoped query on shadow_review_findings for those run ids, the same filters as getShadowReviewFindings (:309). Add `storedScoreSuperseded: true`. Do not UPDATE the stored columns; they are the audit record of what was shown.
2. Apply the same rule in server/services/shadow-review/shadow-review-view-assembler.ts (:53-98), so that both read paths return the deterministic aggregate.
3. In client/src/concept2cure/v2/surfaces/SubmissionSeqWorkspaces.tsx, add scoreBasis and storedScoreSuperseded to ShadowRunRow (:1168). At :1380-1381, render a visible marker (e.g. 'recomputed from findings') with an accessible title when storedScoreSuperseded is true.
4. Update the wording in client/src/concept2cure/v2/surfaces/ShadowReview.tsx:137 and :196-203, so that a v1.0 run reads 'recomputed from the findings' severities; the score this run recorded under prompt v1.0 is not shown'.
5. In scripts/seed/ga-demo.d/107-shadow-review.mjs:206, write 'shadow-review@v1.1' instead of 'shadow-review@v1.0', because scoreDims (:135) is the severity aggregate. The seed is laptop-only, so no migration is involved.
6. Work on concept2cure-v2 only, and merge, never rebase.
records.acceptance: (a) Failing first: a pglite test inserts a shadow_review_runs row with prompt_version 'shadow-review@v1.0', rtf_risk_score 0.95 and one open 'minor' rtf finding. It asserts that listShadowReviewRuns returns rtfRiskScore 0.275 (aggregateRisk) with scoreBasis 'model_reported' and storedScoreSuperseded true. It is red at HEAD 94b4f9238, which returns 0.95, and green after the change. (b) The same assertion holds for shadow-review-view-assembler. (c) A v1.1 run is returned unchanged. (d) A grep shows that no client file renders rtfRiskScore or crlRiskScore without reading scoreBasis. (e) The seed file contains no 'shadow-review@v1.0'.

records.title: Submission Readiness: required Module 1 is now an error, but an imported validator report still never reaches the gate, the rule corpus is unversioned, and dispatch still needs an AI Shadow Review
records.evidenceAtHead: Fixed: server/services/ectd/dispatch-readiness.ts requiredSectionFindings (~:655-697) emits severity 'error' MISSING_REQUIRED_SECTION for codes in requiredByRegulation. server/services/ectd/assess-dispatch-readiness.ts readinessOptionsForSequence (:138-175), used at :719, sets requiredByRegulation for US ind/nda/bla/anda, EU maa and JP jnda originals from regulationRequiredModule1 (server/services/region-profiles/region-profile-service.ts:169), and holds continuing US sequences to 1.1 (Form 1571/356h, :102-108). IND originals also get IND_MODULE3_REQUIRED. Ran a tsx script against computeDispatchReadiness with a cover-letter-only FDA IND 0000: errors=6, all severity 'error' (1.1, 1.3, 1.12.14, 1.14.4.1, 1.14.4.2, 1.20). Still open: (a) no caller passes externalValidationReport. Every call (submission-service.ts:750,1448,1982,2109; routes/submissions.ts:1176,1779; mcp/tools/readiness.ts:34; AnaToolExecutor.ts:10485) passes only {sequenceId, organizationId}. The imported LORENZ report is stored only on ectd_compilations.external_validation (server/routes/ectd-compile.ts:1627-1650), with reportSha256 of the report text but no package sha256. (b) server/services/ectd/validation-rule-corpus.ts has 40 rule entries (16 dispatch-readiness, 4 ectd-validator, 9 packager, 7 external…) with internal ids. Sources are cited as families (FDA_CRIT, :84), and no FDA validation-criteria version is pinned. (c) evaluateShadowPresenceGate (assess-dispatch-readiness.ts:357-367) still blocks unless countCompletedShadowRuns (:499-514) >0. There is no signed human-review substitute (grep).
records.fixedBy: d155ef099, aac603a1b, 613e24e70 (assess-dispatch-readiness.ts:95-175 readinessOptionsForSequence; dispatch-readiness.ts requiredSectionFindings error severity), 4ad6118fc (IND Module 3 required)
records.remaining: (1) An imported eValidator report is not bound to the package sha256 and is never passed to the dispatch gate. The external gate stays 'not assessed' (or fails closed when ECTD_REQUIRE_EVALIDATOR is set in production) even after a report with errors has been imported. (2) The rule corpus is 40 internal, unversioned rules, not pinned to an FDA eCTD validation-criteria version. (3) Dispatch still requires a completed LLM Shadow Review run. With AI disabled or the provider unavailable, the run fails (PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE) and dispatch cannot clear, and there is no signed human-review substitute.
records.severityRationale: The most consequential defect is closed: a missing required Module 1 section (e.g. no Form 1571 under 1.1) used to be a warning and is now a blocking error. The remaining gaps fail closed or show honestly. The external gate shows 'not assessed' rather than clear. A missing Shadow Review blocks rather than passes. Corpus depth is disclosed through enforcement:'external'. For a founder-supported FDA pilot that validates externally, these belong before enterprise GA. Folding in the imported report becomes P1 as soon as the pilot is told to rely on Submission Readiness instead of the separate eValidator report.
records.humanTestingNote: (1) A tester who imports a LORENZ eValidator JSON report with errors in eCTD Compile still sees the Submission Readiness external gate as 'not assessed'. The imported errors are not counted, and the sequence can read dispatch-clear on the other gates. (2) Dispatch requires a completed Shadow Review. In a test environment with no AI provider key configured, Shadow Review fails ('Shadow review could not be completed') and Dispatch stays blocked with 'No completed Shadow Review has run for this sequence'. Workaround: configure the AI gateway provider key in the test environment, run Shadow Review once, and read imported eValidator results in eCTD Compile directly.
records.instructions:
1. Bind the import to a package: in server/routes/ectd-compile.ts, add `packageSha256` to ImportedExternalValidation (:1531) and set it in importDraft (:1590) from the compilation's compiled-package sha256. Read that from the compilation row inside storeImportedReport (:1627) under the existing FOR UPDATE lock. If the compilation has no recorded package sha256, refuse the import with 409 NO_COMPILED_PACKAGE. Persist the compiled package sha256 on ectd_compilations if no column holds it today. A new column goes in a new IF NOT EXISTS migration appended to C2C_MIGRATION_FILES (scripts/db/migration-set.mjs) before the final tenant-sweep pair (ci:migration-set-order).
2. Feed the gate: in server/services/ectd/assess-dispatch-readiness.ts, before evaluateExternalValidationGate (~:766), add a helper loadImportedExternalReport(sequence, organizationId). It reads the newest ectd_compilations row for (organization_id, submission_id, sequence_number) whose external_validation is set, and maps its findings to an ExternalValidationReport (server/services/ectd/external-validator types). Pass it as `report` when params.externalValidationReport is absent.
3. Close the binding at transmit: in transmitSequence (server/services/submission-service/submission-service.ts ~:2109, after the bundle is assembled), when an imported report was used, refuse if bundle.sha256 !== report.packageSha256, with a blocker naming both hashes ('the eValidator report covers a different package'). Do the same in the dispatch path (~:1982) if it assembles.
4. Pin the corpus: in server/services/ectd/validation-rule-corpus.ts, add `export const FDA_VALIDATION_CRITERIA = { title: 'Specifications for eCTD Validation Criteria', version: '<version>', effective: '<date>' }`, where regulatory affairs supplies the version and date from the FDA spreadsheet; this is a founder/regulatory action. Reference it from every fda-region rule, and expose it on the dispatch gate view (DispatchGateView rule). Add a test asserting every rule with region 'fda' cites it.
5. Shadow Review substitute (founder decision first): if approved, add POST /api/submissions/sequences/:seqId/shadow-review/attest in server/routes/submissions.ts. It requires requireRole(AUTHOR) plus a Part 11 signature bound to the sequence (reuse the freeze/dispatch signing in submission-service.ts ~:1274-1289), is allowed only when the AI gateway reports no provider or the org has AI disabled, and records a shadow_review_runs row with model 'human', prompt_version 'human-attestation@v1', status 'complete', null scores and an audit row. Count it in countCompletedShadowRuns (:499). No new table is needed. If the founder declines, record that dispatch requires AI and say so in the Dispatch blocker text.
6. Work on concept2cure-v2 only, merge never rebase, and follow Rule 1 for any schema change.
records.acceptance: (a) Regression, already green: an FDA IND 0000 with only a 1.2 leaf yields MISSING_REQUIRED_SECTION severity 'error' for 1.1. (b) Failing first: a pglite test imports an eValidator report with 1 error against a compilation for sequence 0000 and calls assessSequenceDispatchReadiness. It expects the external gate to be not cleared, with a blocker naming the report's error. It is red at HEAD 94b4f9238 (the gate is notAssessed/cleared) and green after steps 1-2. (c) A report whose packageSha256 differs from the assembled bundle is refused at transmit; red first. (d) A corpus test asserts that every fda rule references FDA_VALIDATION_CRITERIA.version; red first. (e) If step 5 is approved: a sequence with zero AI runs and a signed attestation clears shadowPresence, and an unsigned attempt is refused with no row written; red first.
records.dependencies: LORENZ (or equivalent) licence and the FDA validation-criteria spreadsheet version (founder/regulatory). Founder decision on a human Shadow Review substitute. CAT2-09 (one transmit spine) so that this gate governs the transmit the UI actually uses. CAT2-11 (PDF technical-conformance preflight) for rule depth.

records.title: Duplicate implementations: /api/qms removed; the parallel eCTD agent, legacy zip builder, dead routes, extra validators and readiness engines remain
records.evidenceAtHead: Removed: server/routes/qms.ts and server/services/qms/qms.service.ts were deleted in 157950309. server/bootstrap/register-document-routes.ts:271-278 records the removal, and server/routes/__tests__/qms-legacy-api-retired.test.ts pins it. Still present at HEAD: (1) server/services/ectd-submission-agent.ts + server/routes/ectd-submission-agent.routes.ts, mounted at /api/ectd-submissions (register-document-routes.ts:23,109-113), with no client caller. A tsx run of launchScopeApiVerdict(buildPrefixMap()) gives 'unmapped', so production refuses it, but it is served where scope is not enforced. (2) server/src/services/ectd.ts buildECTDZip is still imported at server/routes/submission-ops.ts:53 and called at :3072 for the device formats. /api/submission-ops/packages/:id/assemble is in launch scope (gateway-transmittals). (3) Dead: server/routes/submissionCenter.routes.ts is imported only to be voided (register-governance-routes.ts:9,64). ectd-stubs/ and infra/ind_mock/ still exist. (4) Validators: submission-gateways/ectd-structural-validator.ts, ectd/ectd4-validator.ts, ectd/ectd-validator-hardening.ts (used by submission-package-orchestrator, submission-sign-release, submission-orchestrator), ectd/dispatch-readiness.ts, external-validator/fda-criteria-adapter.ts, and the ectd-submission-agent inline rules. (5) Readiness engines: /api/submission-readiness (routes/submission-readiness.ts; verdict out-of-scope), /api/dossier-readiness (routes/dossier-readiness.ts; unmapped; called by Dossier.tsx:64), submission-ops/readiness-engine.ts computePackageReadiness (launch, the GatewayTransmittals spine), ind-lifecycle/ind-readiness-service.ts (out-of-scope), submission-readiness/procurement-preflight.ts (MCP tool, mcp/tools/readiness.ts:108), orchestration/readiness-engine.ts, report-os/regional/filing-readiness.ts. (6) AnA QMS duplicates: AnaToolExecutor.ts ~:14218-14400 create_qms_document, revise_qms_document and ack_training write qms_documents and qms_training_records with their own SQL instead of the /api/mdx/qms implementation. ack_training still stores a model-supplied quiz_score.
records.remaining: Everything except /api/qms: the /api/ectd-submissions agent and data model, buildECTDZip (live for estar/eudamed_register), submissionCenter.routes.ts, ectd-stubs/, infra/ind_mock/, six validators, seven or more readiness computations, and the AnA QMS write duplicates.
records.severityRationale: The duplicate with real exposure, /api/qms (unaudited training writes for any userId), is gone. Of the rest, /api/ectd-submissions and /api/dossier-readiness are unmapped and /api/submission-readiness is out-of-scope, so all three are refused in production by the launch-scope API gate. The pilot-relevant consequences of the remaining live duplicates are tracked as their own findings: buildECTDZip in CAT2-10, the package transmit and readiness engine in CAT2-09, and AnA ack_training in CAT2-21. What remains here is zero-duplication hygiene and drift risk, which belongs before enterprise GA.
records.instructions:
Before each deletion, run `git log --all --diff-filter=D -- <path>` and name the replacing file and the gate that proves it is reachable in the commit message (CLAUDE.md working agreement). Work on concept2cure-v2 only, merge never rebase.
1. /api/ectd-submissions: remove the mount at server/bootstrap/register-document-routes.ts:23 and :109-113. Delete server/routes/ectd-submission-agent.routes.ts, server/services/ectd-submission-agent.ts and server/services/__tests__/ectd-submission-agent-*.test.ts. Update the references in server/services/audit/domain-history-link.ts:145 and server/services/ectd/pdfa-detect.ts:7. Replacement: /api/submissions (server/routes/submissions.ts + server/services/submission-service/submission-service.ts), which Submission Center calls. Leave its tables in place. If they are to go, amend their creating migration in place with a dated header note (Rule 1; see scripts/db/migration-set.mjs:618) and never append a DROP.
2. Dead Submission Center family: delete server/routes/submissionCenter.routes.ts and the `void submissionCenterRoutes` import at server/bootstrap/register-governance-routes.ts:9 and :64. The comment there calls this a product call, so get founder sign-off. Replacement: /api/submissions.
3. Delete ectd-stubs/ together with scripts/validate-ectd-stubs-bundle.ts, and infra/ind_mock/, after grep confirms no other reference (package.json scripts, CI workflows).
4. buildECTDZip (after CAT2-10): in server/routes/submission-ops.ts:3071-3080, replace the device branch. 'estar' gets the official filled eSTAR PDF from the 510(k) eSTAR official-fill route (server/routes/510k-estar-routes.ts). 'eudamed_register' is refused for the FDA-only scope. Then delete server/src/services/ectd.ts and the import at submission-ops.ts:53.
5. Readiness: keep server/services/ectd/assess-dispatch-readiness.ts + dispatch-readiness.ts as the one sequence gate. As part of CAT2-09, make the GatewayTransmittals transmit call assessSequenceDispatchReadiness and delete server/submission-ops/readiness-engine.ts computePackageReadiness and its callers (routes/submission-ops.ts:48, submission-ops/automation-runner.ts, services/orchestration/*). Delete /api/submission-readiness (server/routes/submission-readiness.ts, server/services/regulatory/submission-readiness.ts; mount at server/bootstrap/register-advanced-platform-routes.ts:136) and /api/dossier-readiness (server/routes/dossier-readiness.ts; mount at register-inline-routes.ts:279; client Dossier.tsx). Both are outside the launch catalog; launch-scope.ts:99-106 records that the dossier map left the app. Do not open work on services/innovation/submission-readiness-twin-service.ts, which is the regulatory digital twin that CLAUDE.md Rule 2 excludes.
6. Validators: keep submission-gateways/ectd-structural-validator.ts for the package and dispatch-readiness.ts for the sequence. Move any rule in ectd/ectd-validator-hardening.ts that neither covers into one of them, with a corpus entry (validation-rule-corpus.ts), then delete the hardening module and repoint its three importers. ectd4-validator.ts stays as the v4 library (CAT2-14).
7. AnA QMS (with CAT2-21): extract the create, revise and acknowledge logic from server/routes/mdx-qms.ts into server/services/qms/ functions. Make both the routes and the AnaToolExecutor handlers (~:14218-14400) call them. Delete the inline SQL and the model-supplied quiz_score write.
8. Add scripts/ci/check-no-parallel-submission-paths.mjs, which fails on any import of a deleted module path or a mount of /api/ectd-submissions, /api/submission-readiness or /api/dossier-readiness. Wire it into .husky/pre-push. Show it failing first by temporarily re-adding one import.
records.acceptance: (a) Failing first: the new CI check fails on HEAD 94b4f9238, which still mounts /api/ectd-submissions and imports buildECTDZip, and passes after steps 1-5.
